input.quote: The term of this Agreement shall commence on the Effective Date and shall continue in full force and effect for an initial period of five (5) years.
input.rationale: Termination is available only for uncured material breach or insolvency; neither party may terminate for convenience during a five-year committed term, which is the walk-away case of no Customer convenience right in a multi-year term. We add a 30 days' notice convenience right with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees (fallback 60–90 days) and leave Commerce One without any convenience right.

input.quote: Thereafter, this Agreement shall automatically renew for subsequent one (1) year periods unless either party provides the other party with written notification at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the initial five (5) year term or any one (1) year renewal thereof of its intention to terminate this Agreement.
input.rationale: Renewals are 12 months with a 30-day non-renewal window exercisable by either party, which meets our preferred position on term length and notice. There is no Vendor renewal reminder and no cap on renewal price uplift (fees for years 2-5 and beyond are set in Exhibit B), which we note rather than flag.
